### Contributing guidelines

- [X] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

### Module(s)

mini.colors

### Question

Hi echasnovski! Is it in scope of mini.colors add_transparency's method to adjust highlights to `DiagnosticSign*` groups so that when we set statuscolumn field in add_transparency to true, it adjust's background of diagnostic sign groups as well. Because of as of now, when the statuscolumn option is set to true in add_transparency method, it sets foldcolumn, signcolumn, linenr[above/below] highlight groups but leaves setting default diagnosticsign* groups which results in mismatch between background colors for statuscolumn and diagnostic signs.

reply_data.body:
I don't think I like to open this door, as it comes with somewhat bothersome need to have to keep this is in mind whenever there are new highlight groups created.

The `add_transparency()` was initially intended as a low-effort (and somewhat gimmicky) way to add transparency to a color scheme that doesn't support it. There is no intention of making it as fully featured as possible. I'll probably add `DiagnosticSignXxx` groups to `statuscolumn` group, though.

@echasnovski also one last question and since it is a small one, I am just asking it here. Is there any reason why `ErrorMsg` highlight group has bg defined while all other highlight groups like WarningMsg, MoreMsg, etc don't have bg set? The reason for me asking this is that with the new extui enabled, the msg window shows all error messages with different background than its own since msg window is a float window and its background is float background.
```lua
hi('ErrorMsg',       {fg=p.base08, bg=p.base00, attr=nil,            sp=nil})
```

comment_data.body:
All the issues here should now be resolved on latest `main`:
- `DiagnosticXxx` and `XxxMsg` groups [are now accounted in `add_transparency()`](https://nvim-mini.org/mini.nvim/CHANGELOG.html#v0.17.0-mini.colors).
- 'mini.base16' and 'mini.hues' do not set background where it is not needed.

reply_data.body:
> Hi @echasnovski, I have some more groups that should get updated by `add_transparency({ float = true })`:
> 
>     * MiniPickPrompt
> 
>     * MiniPickPromptPrefix
> 
>     * MiniPickPromptCaret
> 
>     * MiniPickBorderText

Those are not built-in highlight groups, so [out of scope for 'mini.colors'](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/discussions/2077#discussioncomment-14722784).

Both 'mini.base16' and 'mini.hues' need those groups to set background equal to picker's floating window background.
